title: Complete Guide to API Versioning Strategies
title_es: Guía Completa de Estrategias de Versionado de APIs
description: Runnable API versioning examples: URI path, query param, header, and content-negotiation routers (FastAPI), GraphQL schema evolution snippets, deprecation/sunset headers, strangler-fig router, and parallel-run comparator.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de versionado de APIs: routers por URI, query param, header y negociación de contenido (FastAPI), evolución de esquema GraphQL, headers deprecation/sunset, router strangler-fig y comparador parallel-run.
